description.value: Nu Leaf Produce Market is a family-run fresh produce shop in Kamloops that has been supplying locally sourced fruits, vegetables, dairy, and pantry staples since 2011, working with over 60 regional farmers and its own Heffley Farms. It recently expanded to a second location at 1415 Hillside Drive, and also produces its own line of BC-fruit juices and reusable bags. Reviewers highlight a broad selection of in-season local produce alongside everyday grocery staples, making it a practical resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through Kamloops.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active business. Two retail locations are listed on the contact page (740 Fortune Dr #2 and 1415 Hillside Dr #18); the site prominently flags 1415 Hillside Drive as 'NEW LOCATION' on every page, but OSM carries no address, so the node cannot be confidently mapped to either without geocoding. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, bike rack, pump, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website. Basic groceries are clearly confirmed by Google reviewer quotes and product listings covering produce, dairy, eggs, beverages, snacks, and pantry staples.
concerns: OSM record carries no address or phone; the website lists two retail locations (740 Fortune Dr #2 and 1415 Hillside Dr #18 — the latter flagged as 'NEW LOCATION'). The OSM node cannot be confidently assigned to one location without geocoding verification. Address and phone in this record reflect the new Hillside Drive location.
OSM tags are minimal (name + shop=greengrocer only); no cycling amenity tags present to cross-check.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established, active daily grocery store with a broad range of fresh local produce and pantry staples — a practical resupply point for touring cyclists in Kamloops.
enrichment_extras.notes: Old location at 740 Fortune Dr #2, Kamloops, BC V2B 1N2 (phone 250-376-8618) may warrant a separate OSM node check. Food service/wholesale division operates from #31-740 Fortune Dr (phone 250-229-5420) and is not a retail stop.
